summary: Agent assisted customer with savings account closure request.

intents.keywords: I want to close my savings account the branch keeps ... this done quickly
intents.actions of agent: Verified account details, offered options for pending balance, initiated closure and transfer.
intents.Process Request: Initiated account closure and fund transfer to customer's other bank.
intents.resolution: Account closure and fund transfer initiated; completion in 3 days.

intents.keywords: I understand there is a pending balance of 500 ... transfer it to my other bank
intents.actions of agent: Offered options for handling the pending balance and processed the transfer request.
intents.Process Request: Initiated fund transfer to customer's other bank.
intents.resolution: Agent initiated the transfer of the 500 rupees balance to the customer's other bank.
